title: Declassified 1950s UFO Reports from Boy Scouts and Other Witnesses Dismissed by SETI Expert
description: A SETI Institute president urges skepticism regarding newly declassified 1952 and 1953 UFO sightings by Boy Scouts and a man near Los Angeles, attributing the high volume of reports from that era to the influence of science fiction and limited technology despite his belief in extraterrestrial life.
